newsitem.title: USA: IBS appeals court ruling in legal spat with group.
newsitem.headline: IBS appeals court ruling in legal spat with group.

text.p: IBS Financial Corp said Friday it had appealed a court ruling that dismissed its case against a group trying to gain a seat on its board of directors.
IBS, a holding company, said it had filed an appeal with the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit against the January 23 ruling that dismissed its case against the group.
IBS had accused Seidman and Associates LLC and other partners of failing to disclose all necessary information in nominating a candidate for its board.
The district court also rejected the company's attempt to reduce the number of board members to six from seven.
